plan.summary: InmaDynamicFieldsCache.GetOrFetchAsync cancellation poison retro-fix: factory captures caller's CancellationToken which propagates into the shared in-flight Task, so the first caller's cancel aborts all joined awaiters. Apply the FEAT-TFM DbTenantFieldMappingResolver pattern: spawn fetch with CancellationToken.None, expose per-caller cancellation via Task.WaitAsync(ct). Adds first unit-test coverage for cache + single-flight semantics.
plan.q_intent: FEAT-DMP cache cancellation poison fix — P1 pilot-launch-roadmap.md FAZ 1. FEAT-TFM iter 3 fix pattern'ini InmaDynamicFieldsCache'e uygula; test ekle; backend-only deploy.
plan.interview_notes: Q1 (testler) = OTOMATIK: Claude unit test ekleyebilecegi kadar yazsin (cancellation isolation + single-flight coalescing + invalidate clears inflight + empty-list caches + exception propagation + invalidate during inflight). acceptance_criteria.criterion: GetOrFetchAsync spawns the in-flight fetch task decoupled from the first caller's CancellationToken (CancellationToken.None or equivalent) so that caller A cancelling mid-flight does NOT abort the shared Task nor raise OperationCanceledException on concurrent caller B.

try_catch_locations: InmaDynamicFieldsCache.FetchAndCacheAsync: try/finally around client.GetFieldsAsync — finally clears _inflight slot. Upstream exceptions (InmaDynamicFieldsFetchException, timeout, etc.) propagate unchanged so Backend proxy maps to 503.
user_facing_errors: No new user-facing errors. Existing 503 surface on fetch failure preserved (FEAT-DMP contract).
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Cache does NOT swallow. Failures clear the inflight slot in finally and propagate. Cancellation isolation means caller A's cancel never becomes caller B's silent failure — that was the BUG this paket fixes.

aha_moments.user_pain: Two concurrent Dashboard tabs opening the placeholder picker can race: if tab A's request is cancelled (tab closed), tab B's picker silently fails with 'upstream fetch fail' even though INMA returned 200.
aha_moments.suggestion: After fix, cancelling one tab's request leaves the underlying fetch alive for the other tab — both tabs complete successfully from a single INMA call.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant admin closes a stale tab and the newly-opened tab still shows the placeholder list immediately — no retry, no error toast.

aha_moments.user_pain: Single-flight is supposed to coalesce 10 concurrent cache-misses into 1 upstream call; when the first caller cancels, the coalescing collapses to 9 individual retries instead.
aha_moments.suggestion: Decoupled inflight keeps 10-fold stampede protection even under churny cancellations (hot reload, navigation).
aha_moments.aha_moment: Prod metric `inma_dynamicfields_upstream_calls_total` stays flat at 1/min per tenant instead of spiking during Dashboard navigation.

aha_moments.user_pain: Tenant reports 'sometimes the placeholder dropdown is empty'. Logs show no INMA error — just a mysterious OperationCanceledException inside the picker hook.
aha_moments.suggestion: Fix removes the source of false-positive cancel reports; support can now trust that placeholder fetch failures have an actual upstream cause.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support ticket 'dropdown boş' triages to 0 in the week after deploy — the only remaining failures are genuine INMA 5xx traceable to tenant secret/network.

aha_moments.user_pain: FlowBuilder NodePropertyPanel refresh button sometimes shows 'Yenilenemedi' even when INMA is healthy — users click repeatedly, unclear why.
aha_moments.suggestion: After fix, refresh is deterministic: result reflects INMA's actual state, not a cancellation race.
aha_moments.aha_moment: User clicks refresh once; value updates predictably; no more 'neden olmadı' frustration.

aha_moments.user_pain: Future services that would reuse InmaDynamicFieldsCache (Outbound/Automation planned via FEAT-TFM-FLOW integration) would inherit the same cancellation poison.
aha_moments.suggestion: Fixing now at the Shared-cache layer preempts re-introducing the bug when DI scope widens.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When Outbound adopts the cache in FEAT-TFM-FLOW, no 'it works locally, fails in prod under concurrency' surprise — pattern is battle-tested from day one.
